title: Frontend Web Designer
description:
Job Title: Web Designer Experience Required: 2+ years
 Immediate Joiner Preferred 
 Location: Onsite Full Time / Gwalior [M.P] Company Overview: 
 SynRam Software Services Pvt. Ltd. is a next-generation technology powerhouse and a key subsidiary of the global leader, FG International GmbH, Germany . Driven by Innovation & Collaboration. In strategic coordination with ISM Technology GmbH , SynRam is actively engineering its own suite of proprietary tech products. We don't just solve problems for our clients; we build the foundational tools that shape the future of the digital landscape. At SynRam, we focus on Scalable Excellence. 
 About the Role We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Web Designer with at least 2 years of hands-on experience in designing modern, responsive, and visually engaging websites. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive web design, typography, color theory, layouts, and visual hierarchy , along with proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools . The candidate should be capable of independently creating website designs from concepts and requirements and converting ideas into modern, user-friendly, and aesthetically appealing digital experiences . 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop responsive, visually appealing, and user-friendly website layouts . Create website designs, landing pages, dashboards, and other digital interfaces based on business requirements. Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma or similar design tools. Apply strong UI/UX principles, visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, color theory, and design consistency . Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices . Create engaging interactive elements, hover effects, transitions, and basic animations where required. Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs. Review implemented designs and ensure pixel-perfect alignment with approved UI designs . Maintain consistency across websites through reusable UI components and design systems . Optimize designs for usability, accessibility, performance, and different screen sizes . Understand user requirements and business objectives to create effective and engaging website experiences. Stay updated with the latest web design, UI/UX, typography, visual design, and interaction design trends . 
 Required Skills & Qualifications (Mandatory) 2+ years of professional experience as a Web Designer. Strong proficiency in Figma and other relevant design tools. Good understanding of UI/UX principles and modern web design standards . Strong knowledge of responsive web design and mobile-first design principles. Good understanding of HTML5 and CSS3 . Knowledge of JavaScript basics will be an added advantage. Experience designing websites, landing pages, dashboards, and web-based interfaces . Strong understanding of typography, color theory, spacing, grids, layouts, and visual hierarchy . Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and high-fidelity UI designs . Knowledge of creating interactive designs, transitions, and basic web animations . Experience working with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain design consistency and quality . Strong creative, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to translate visual designs into pixel-accurate web experiences. Experience creating scroll-based animations, micro-interactions, transitions, and interactive web experiences. Knowledge of the Angular framework is a plus. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, or similar creative tools is a plus. Portfolio of previous web design/UI work is required. Ability to translate visual designs into pixel-accurate web experiences. Experience creating scroll-based animations, micro-interactions, transitions, and interactive web experiences. Knowledge of the Angular framework is a plus. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, or similar creative tools is a plus. 
 Preferred Attributes: Ability to independently handle website design projects from concept to final design . Understanding of UX research, user flows, usability, and accessibility . Experience creating and maintaining design systems and reusable UI components . Basic knowledge of frontend development and ability to understand HTML/CSS implementation limitations . Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or similar . Experience designing SaaS products, ERP systems, dashboards, or business applications will be an added advantage. Enthusiastic about exploring new web design techniques, UI/UX trends, design tools, and interaction patterns . Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders . 
 If you are an Immediate Joiner and passionate about creating modern, engaging, and user-friendly digital experiences, apply now and be a part of an exciting learning journey with SynRam Software Services Pvt.Ltd. 
 Mail us on: career@synram.co
 Call us on: +91-9111381555 Job Types: Full-time, Permanent 
 Benefits: Flexible schedule Health insurance 
 Application Question(s): Are you an Immediate Joiner ? Do you have a portfolio of Web Design/UI work ? Are you comfortable working onsite from Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh ? 
 Experience: Web Designer: 2 years (Required) 
 Language: English (Required) 
 Work Location: In person
